finish.line: I've started something I can't finish
stanza: I've started something I can't finish
And I barely leave the house it's true
I keep a wrap on my sores and joints
But I've guess I've had my blessings too

finish.songTitle: Killing Me Softly With His Song
finish.line: I prayed that he would finish
stanza: I felt all flushed with fever
I felt he found my letters
Then read each one out loud
I prayed that he would finish
But he just kept right on
